speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore remains one of the safest countries in the world.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: But the global security environment is increasingly volatile.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Terrorists and extremists have also exploited the conflicts to radicalise and recruit and incite violence.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: At the same time, transnational and cyber-enabled crimes continue to grow in scale and sophistication.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Drug trafficking remains a huge concern, while scams and cybercrimes pose an unprecedented challenge to law enforcement.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Singapore’s approach to criminal justice rests on three key thrusts: certainty of law, certainty of enforcement and certainty of punishment.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Underpinning these is a set of laws that allows us to effectively deter, detect and enforce against crime.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will regularly review our laws to ensure that they remain fit-for-purpose, to deal with emerging threats and evolving criminal tactics.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are also working on strengthening legislation to deal with challenges such as scams and drugs.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MHA leverages partnerships to extend the Home Team’s effectiveness and impact.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, to tackle the growing threat of youth self-radicalisation, the Internal Security Department and SGSecure Programme Office are working with the Ministry of Education to sensitise students and school staff to the terror threat, indicators of radicalisation and importance of early reporting.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MHA is working closely with other agencies to counter increasingly permissive attitudes worldwide towards drugs, such as through strengthening preventive drug education initiatives.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To support the rehabilitation and reintegration of inmates and ex-offenders, the Singapore Prison Service (SPS) and Yellow Ribbon Singapore will partner other Government agencies, employers and community organisations under the ambit of the Community Action for the Rehabilitation of Ex-Offenders (CARE) Network, which celebrated its 25th anniversary this year.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Working with the Home Team Science and Technology Agency (HTX), Home Team Departments will step up efforts to harness technology as a force multiplier.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Technology investments have also improved the Home Team’s delivery of services to Singaporeans.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Immigration & Checkpoints Authority put in place automated gates, equipped with forgery detection and multi-modal biometrics screening systems, to allow for more secure border control while providing a seamless clearance experience.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: SPS is trialling an Autonomous Televisit System to make inmate visits more accessible to families, with secure identity verification through facial recognition technology.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Singapore Police Force (SPF) leverages drones and AI to support major security deployments.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: During the Marina Bay Singapore Countdown 2025, SPF and HTX used AI to analyse real-time drone footage, assess crowd sizes and improve operational responses.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The Central Narcotics Bureau’s (CNB's) Next-Generation Reporting Centre will streamline urine testing through automation, strengthening the robustness of the urine testing process, and reducing biohazard risks for CNB officers.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Most importantly, MHA will continue to build and maintain public trust in the Home Team.

speaker: The Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: With strong public trust, and by working together as One Home Team, we can confront emerging and evolving threats and keep Singapore safe and secure.
